description.value:
A uniform matching one organization's janitors, builders, caterers or crew. Where it belongs, you can walk a leg in the open: COOL + Acting at +2 instead of DEX + Stealth against the Awareness Ladder DV, until they're Alert. Price by security: low (convenience store) 50eb (Premium); moderate (building site, hospital) 100eb (Expensive); high (small corp) 500eb (Very Expensive); extreme (megacorp) 1,000eb (Luxury).

Cost: 50–1,000eb

Item Compendium (2070) • Gear & Goods
